subject: Hilary Knight will play for PWHL expansion Detroit via sign-and-trade with Las Vegas
posts: A legendary shift in the PWHL landscape as Hilary Knight heads to Detroit. Professional sports expansion relies on star power to anchor new markets and build sustainable fan bases. #PWHL #Hockey

Hilary Knight, one of the most decorated players in hockey history, is moving to the new Detroit PWHL expansion team. This sign-and-trade deal is a strategic move to ensure the new franchise has a veteran leader to build around.

This move brings high-level professional hockey to a new city, inspiring local youth and providing a massive boost to the league's overall brand and reach.
